positions.title: Software Engineer

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Wrote Python scripts to organize/parse high volume conference call transcripts and financial disclosures
• Explored relationship between causal language frequency and sentiment of earnings reports
o Hypothesized that causal language appears more frequently in reports of poor financial performance

positions.title: Digital Analytics Co-op
positions.description:
•	Queried and analyzed web traffic data of 10M+ monthly unique visitors using Adobe Analytics
•	Tailored ad-hoc Excel reports to meet needs of cross-functional teams
•	Implemented clustering analysis (DBSCAN) in Python/Tableau to visualize paper delivery errors
•	Independently conceptualized and designed predictive model for digital subscriptions
o	Used regression random forest learning in R to calculate expected values
o	Final model explained 71% of variance and was presented to Director of Analytics

positions.title: Direct Marketing/Fundraising Intern
positions.description:
•	Conducted face-to-face fundraising campaigns for Save the Children and The Nature Conservancy
•	Approached and stopped total strangers using outgoingness and creativity
•	Persuaded potential donors to subscribe to $30/month giving plans or $420 one-time gifts
•	Recognized for maintaining 100% donor retention rate
•	Projected funds raised: $11,000+
